versions.changelog:
- Skill renamed to "rollinggo-searchhotel" and updated all relevant names/metadata.
- Skill documentation, command descriptions, and trigger phrases are now fully localized in Simplified Chinese.
- New pre-flight API key check: CLI commands are only executed if ROLLINGGO_API_KEY is configured; otherwise, users are prompted to obtain and set an API key.
- Updated homepage and documentation links to https://rollinggo.store.
- Referenced new environment configuration instructions via references/claw-host-env.md.
- Removed the old skill-card.md; added explicit version and freshness policy (always use latest CLI release).

Initial release of RollingGo Hotel CLI skill.

- Enables hotel search and pricing using the RollingGo CLI with structured natural language filtering (destination, dates, guests, ratings, budget, tags, distance).
- Supports inspection of hotel details, real-time room pricing, policies, and availability by hotel ID.
- Allows tag lookup to enable precise filtering (e.g., amenities, brands).
- Includes booking links and detailed hotel page URLs in results.
- Provides guidance for environment setup and API key usage.
- Outlines fallback strategies when searches return insufficient results.
